description: Edit this sheet of eight small chibi pixel art figures: the top row walks towards the viewer, the bottom row walks away from the viewer. Dress every figure in the same outfit and change nothing else: keep each figure's pose, size, place, bald head, ears and face exactly as they are, with the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour. The outfit is a pumpkin king's: a fitted deep violet coat with long sleeves to the wrist and a short flared hem, embroidered with curling orange pumpkin vines and green leaves, closed down the front with round orange buttons shaped like little carved pumpkin faces, an orange sash at the waist, orange-and-black striped trousers and black boots with big brass buckles. Seen from behind, the coat's back shows the vine embroidery and no buttons. The hands stay bare. Transparent background, nothing else added.
